    queue = build_queue(sources.data["run_id"], observations["batches"], versions, all_reviews, people)
    snapshots, summaries = [], []
    for batch in observations["batches"]:
        number = batch["batch_id"]
        visible = [version for version in versions if version["batch"] <= number]
        current = {identity: max((v for v in visible if v["id"] == identity), key=lambda v: v["revision"])
                   for identity in batch["claims"]}
        claims = [_claim_row(identity, batch["claims"][identity], current[identity], completion_accepted) for identity in sorted(current)]
        by_id = {claim["claim_id"]: claim for claim in claims}
        issues = []
        for identity, observed in batch["claims"].items():

            basis_observation = observations["batches"][request["accepted_arrival_batch"] - 1]["claims"][request["claim_id"]]
            status = ("held" if request["holds"] or request["retry_needed"] else "cancelled" if request["cancelled"]
                      else "cancel-pending" if request["cancellation_requested"] else "settled" if request["net_paid_cents"] == request["current_obligation_cents"]
                      else "accepted")
            requests.append(dict(request_id=identity, claim_id=request["claim_id"], revision=basis["revision"],
                amount_cents=request["current_obligation_cents"], payee=request["payee_id"], currency=request["currency"], status=status,
                decision_ids=basis_observation["authority"]["valid_decision_ids"], original_amount_cents=request["initial_obligation_cents"],
                paid_cents=request["paid_cents"], refunded_cents=request["refunded_cents"], net_paid_cents=request["net_paid_cents"],
                accepted_at=request["accepted_time"], accepted_arrival_batch=request["accepted_arrival_batch"],
                source_ids=request["source_refs"], admitted_event_ids=request["admitted_event_ids"],
                resolution_event_ids=request["resolution_event_ids"], retry_authorized=request["retry_authorized"], retry_needed=request["retry_needed"]))
        cancellations = []
        for process in batch["cancellation_processes"]["processes"]:
            target_versions = [v for v in visible if v["trip"] == process["trip"] and v["trip_revision"] == process["trip_revision"]]
            affected = sorted({v["id"] for v in target_versions})
            originals = []
            for request in requests:
                if any(v["id"] == request["claim_id"] and v["revision"] == request["revision"] for v in target_versions):

            person = people[trip["Employee ID"]]

            resolved = bool(affected) and all(by_id[identity]["financial_completion_accepted"] for identity in affected)
            financial = "no-financial-effect" if no_costs else "resolved" if resolved else "unresolved"

            owner = person["Supervisor"] if process["status"] == "requested" else None if financial != "unresolved" else person["Finance officer"]
            if process["status"] == "requested":

                effective_at=_stamp(process["confirmed_time"]).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z") if process["confirmed_time"] else None,

                issue_record_ids=sorted(set(linked_issues)), source_ids=process["source_refs"], arrangements_paused=True,

                permit_retired=process["status"] == "confirmed" and process["permit"] is not None))
        for hold in batch["cancellation_processes"]["holds"]:
            issues.append(dict(record_id=_record_id(hold.get("event_id"), 1, hold["code"], str(hold["delivery"])),
                subject_type="travel_cancellation", subject_id=hold.get("cancellation_id"), revision=hold["delivery"].get("Trip revision"),
                code=hold["code"], reason=hold["reason"], owner=hold["owner"], resolution_needed=hold["next_action"], blocking=True, source_ids=hold["source_refs"]))
        reviews = visible_at(all_reviews, number)
        review_ids = {row["Decision reference"] for row in reviews}
        packets = [packet for packet in all_packets if packet["Decision reference"] in review_ids]
        permits = []
        for trip in trips:
            if not trip["Permit reference"]:
                continue
            person = people[trip["Employee ID"]]
            subject = dict(id=trip["Permit reference"], revision=trip["Permit revision"], employee=trip["Employee ID"], source_ref=trip["_ref"])
            permits.append(dict(permit_id=trip["Permit reference"], permit_revision=trip["Permit revision"], trip_id=trip["Trip reference"],
                trip_revision=trip["Trip revision"], assessment=assess_permission(subject, trip, person, reviews, packets, batch["cancellation_processes"], sources)))
        snapshot = dict(schema_version="travel-claim-snapshot/2", run_id=sources.data["run_id"], batch_id=str(number),
            predecessor=None if not snapshots else dict(path=f"{number-1}.json", sha256=sha256(encoded(snapshots[-1])).hexdigest()),
            source_binding=dict(path="../sources.json", sha256=sha256(sources.path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()),
            claims=claims, requests=requests, travel_cancellations=cancellations, admitted_event_ids=finance["admitted_event_ids"], issues=issues,
            finance_events=finance["admitted_events"], rejected_finance_events=finance["rejected_events"],
            replayed_finance_event_ids=finance["replayed_event_ids"], replayed_cancellation_event_ids=batch["cancellation_processes"]["replayed_event_ids"],
            decisions=reviews, review_packets=packets, permits=permits,
            budget_groups=list({tuple(obs["budget"]["group"]):obs["budget"] for obs in batch["claims"].values()}.values()),
            completion_choice_adopted=completion_accepted, case_clock=sources.data["case_clock"], case_timezone=sources.data["case_timezone"])
        snapshots.append(snapshot)
        summaries.append(dict(batch_id=number, claims=len(claims), statuses=dict(Counter(claim["status"] for claim in claims)),
            known_allowed_cents=sum(claim["allowed_cents"] for claim in claims if claim["allowed_cents"] is not None), unknown_claims=sum(claim["allowed_cents"] is None for claim in claims),
            gross_paid_cents=sum(claim["gross_paid_cents"] for claim in claims), refunded_cents=sum(claim["refunded_cents"] for claim in claims), net_paid_cents=sum(claim["paid_cents"] for claim in claims),
            accepted_obligation_cents=sum(request["amount_cents"] for request in requests), request_count=len(requests), finance_event_count=len(finance["admitted_event_ids"]),

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("preview", "seal", "verify"))
    parser.add_argument("--sources", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--schema", type=Path, default=Path("snapshot.schema.json"))
    parser.add_argument("--completion-accepted", action="store_true", help="Use only after the learner's captured source-grounded choice 3")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "seal" and not args.completion_accepted:
        parser.error("Sealing the final workflow requires the learner's actual completion choice; preview remains available")
    root = args.sources.resolve().parent
    result = build_run(args.sources, args.completion_accepted)
    if args.mode == "preview":
        immutable(root / "preview" / "summary.json", encoded(result["summaries"]))
        immutable(root / "preview" / "repair-queue.json", encoded(result["queue"]))
        immutable(root / "preview" / "report.md", render_report(result, args.sources, preview=True))
    else:
        previous = None
        for snapshot in result["snapshots"]:
            path = root / "batches" / (snapshot["batch_id"] + ".json")
            if args.mode == "verify":
                if not path.exists() or path.read_bytes() != encoded(snapshot):
                    raise SourceError("Missing or distinct sealed replay: " + str(path))
                validate_snapshot(snapshot, args.schema, args.sources, previous, snapshot_path=path)
            else:
                write_snapshot(path, snapshot, args.schema, args.sources, previous)
            previous = path
        for name, content in (("claims.csv", claims_csv(result["snapshots"][-1])), ("repair-queue.json", encoded(result["queue"])), ("report.md", render_report(result, args.sources)), ("summary.json", encoded(result["summaries"]))):
            if args.mode == "verify":
                if (root / name).read_bytes() != (content.encode() if isinstance(content,str) else content):
                    raise SourceError("Run output differs on unchanged replay: " + name)
            else:
                immutable(root / name, content)
    print(json.dumps(dict(mode=args.mode, run_id=root.name, batches=result["summaries"]), indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def encoded(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False, default=str) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def immutable(path, content):
    path = Path(path)
    data = content.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(content, str) else content
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if path.exists():
        if path.read_bytes() != data:
            raise SourceError("Distinct sealed output preserved; use a new run: " + str(path))
    else:
        with path.open("xb") as stream:
            stream.write(data)

# Native source acquisition and safe resume

Read the five URLs from the learner's unchanged original interview; the supplied policy slug resolves to POL-2026.2. Source URLs are evidence inputs, not permission to edit remote content. Current source identities and locators are retained in the selected run's `sources.json`.

For each new collection, attempt all five native locations through the browser or connected Google Drive tools. Record the actual completed observation time, native URL/locator and observed version. Retain unsuccessful scope with status `unavailable`, actual error and null path/hash/version; retain usable partial pieces separately. Never copy a previous manifest's observation time or claim fresh access from a URL/hash alone.

## PDF binders

Read Drive metadata before raw fetch. Use `fetch(download_raw_file=true, include_base64=false)` for these stored PDFs. Materialize the returned authenticated file reference into `retained/`; keep signed download links out of the repository. Preserve the raw complete bytes. Extract every page with `pypdf.PdfReader(...).pages`, retaining UTF-8 page records `{page, text}` and original wording in layout mode. Inspect page counts and empty pages, read every relevant record and visually check ambiguous layout.

The adapter source IDs are `INITIAL`, `UPDATES`, `RECEIPTS` for raw files and `INITIAL-PAGES`, `UPDATES-PAGES`, `RECEIPTS-PAGES` for extracted page arrays. Text derivatives are optional. The adapter parses the supplied SRC-D-3 claim and receipt layouts; a changed incompatible layout is a source-format defect to diagnose, not permission to guess fields.

## Workbook

Read spreadsheet metadata to discover actual tab names/IDs and bounds. Export the entire native workbook to XLSX. Read bounded native CellData for every populated tab, including headers/notes, `formattedValue`, `effectiveValue` and `userEnteredValue`. Retain each complete native response as `REGISTERS-<UPPERCASE-TAB-WITH-HYPHENS>`; `Sources.table` reads row-five headings and records starting at row six. Current tabs are People, Trips, Merchant payments, FX, Caps, Budget, Review ledger, Review packets, Finance activity and Travel cancellations.

Compare every populated native value with the complete export, including numeric precision and calendar/date representation. Preserve the source timezone metadata, but interpret local calendar dates and UTC event timestamps using the actual policy, not the workbook display timezone. Effective cap dates exposed as Excel serials are calendar dates. Record hidden/unread content, comments, formulas or external references when present; a successful header read is insufficient evidence of whole-workbook access.

## Policy

Use the browser to read and retain the complete original policy, including later paragraphs loaded by scrolling. Exclude browser chrome. Preserve original words and version in `POLICY`; document plain-text formatting normalization. When a freshly read document is unchanged, explicit comparison with the prior original representation is allowed; do not silently substitute an old document or an AI summary.

Retain the full prior event/version history plus new records. The runner observes all supplied arrival numbers in order and reconstructs the complete chain; it does not invent historical execution timestamps. Revisit learner constraints if changed evidence alters their basis. Start with `preview`, resolve adoption or input gaps, then seal and verify with the exact commands in README. ---
name: scan-agent-skill
description: Scan a local agent skill package for prompt injection, data exfiltration, malicious code, obfuscation, and risky tool use with a pinned security scanner. Use before installing or executing a third-party skill, after modifying a skill, or before handing a skill over. Do not use a clean scan as proof that a skill is safe.
---

# Scan an agent skill

Run a repeatable security check without copying the scanner or its dependencies into the workspace.
The wrapper uses [Cisco AI Skill Scanner `2.0.13`](https://github.com/cisco-ai-defense/skill-scanner/releases/tag/2.0.13),
released under Apache-2.0 at commit `ec7c7f09c38c30af00e145e113b69fae96cbeb1a`.

## Input

Require one local path: a skill directory, `SKILL.md`, or the lowercase `skill.md` used for a Fellow's
deliverable. Download a remote skill for inspection before scanning it; do not scan and execute a
remote repository in one step.

## Workflow

1. Run `scripts/scan.sh <path>` from this skill directory.
2. If the script reports that `skill-scanner` is missing, explain that installation downloads a large
   third-party Python dependency set and writes to the user's pipx tool environment. Ask before running:

   ```bash
   pipx install cisco-ai-skill-scanner==2.0.13
   ```

   If `pipx` itself is unavailable, stop and ask the user how they want Python tools installed. Do not
   choose a system-wide `pip` installation for them.
3. Re-run the wrapper after installation. Keep the default local-only scan. Do not enable LLM,
   VirusTotal, Cisco AI Defense, file uploads, or API keys unless the user explicitly requests and
   approves that separate data flow. The wrapper also forces LiteLLM to use its bundled model-cost
   map so that dependency does not make an incidental pricing-data request during startup.
4. Read the detailed Markdown report. Report the command's exit status, each finding's severity and
   evidence path, and a disposition:
   fix, accept with a stated reason, or investigate manually.
5. Inspect the skill manually even when the scanner reports no findings. Check its instructions,
   scripts, hidden files, network destinations, credential access, and destructive operations.

## Interpretation

- A non-zero result means the scan failed or found an issue at the configured threshold; read the
  output before deciding which.
- A finding is evidence to review, not proof of malicious intent.
- No findings means only that this scanner version and policy detected none. It is not certification,
  and it never replaces human review.

## Gotchas

- **Auto-installing the scanner.** The dependency is much larger than this wrapper. Ask before changing
  the user's tool environment.
- **Uploading a client's skill for a stronger scan.** Local scanning is the default. Never send client
  material or hashes to a cloud analyzer without explicit approval.
- **Scanning only `SKILL.md`.** Scripts and bundled resources carry most executable risk. Pass the
  entire skill directory.
- **Treating severity as disposition.** A high-severity false positive still needs a recorded reason;
  a low-severity real exfiltration path still needs repair.

## Quality guidelines

Adhere to:

- `library/reference/agent-quality-guidelines.md` for runtime behavior.
- `library/reference/skill-architecture.md` for structural principles.

`library/` here is the plugin's library: the folder two levels above this skill's own folder.

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

from travel_expense_claim.verify_independence import Sources
from travel_expense_claim.workflow import build_run, render_report


MANIFEST = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "artifacts/runs/submission-20261017T154939Z/sources.json"


class WorkflowHandoffTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_report_uses_exact_cancellation_target_and_traceable_queue_changes(self):
        result = build_run(MANIFEST)
        report = render_report(result, MANIFEST, preview=True)
        self.assertIn("| TC122 | trip T122 / 1 |", report)
        self.assertNotIn("trip P122", report)
        self.assertIn("| TC121 | permit P121 / 1 |", report)
        self.assertIn("| 1 | C21 / 1 |", report)
        claims = {row["claim_id"]: row for row in result["snapshots"][-1]["claims"]}
        self.assertEqual(claims["C21"]["next_owner"], "LEAD-01")
        self.assertEqual(claims["C119"]["next_owner"], "DIR-01")
        self.assertEqual(claims["C18"]["next_owner"], "FIN-01")
        processes = {row['cancellation_id']:row for row in result['snapshots'][-1]['travel_cancellations']}
        for identity in ['TC019','TC121']:
            self.assertEqual(processes[identity]['next_owner'], 'Learner')
            self.assertTrue(processes[identity]['source_financial_prerequisites_observed'])
        self.assertEqual(processes['TC018']['next_owner'], 'FIN-01')

    def test_confirmed_refund_alone_does_not_resolve_the_earlier_overpayment(self):
        original = Sources.table
        def changed(sources, name):
            rows = deepcopy(original(sources, name))
            if name == "Finance activity":
                rows = [row for row in rows if row["Activity reference"] != "F-C20-3"]
            return rows
        with patch.object(Sources, "table", changed):
            result = build_run(MANIFEST, completion_accepted=True)
        final = next(claim for claim in result["snapshots"][-1]["claims"] if claim["claim_id"] == "C20")
        self.assertEqual(final["paid_cents"], 10000)
        self.assertEqual(final["balance_cents"], 0)
        self.assertTrue(final["finance_resolution_required"])
        self.assertEqual(final["status"], "held")
        self.assertFalse(final["financial_completion_accepted"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

        processes = {row['cancellation_id']:row for row in result['snapshots'][-1]['travel_cancellations']}
        for identity in ['TC019','TC121']:
            self.assertEqual(processes[identity]['next_owner'], 'Learner')

        with patch.object(Sources, "table", changed):
